name: io.github.harisnopen/diavlos
title: Diavlos
description: Signed messages between AI agents. Dangerous actions wait for a human-signed approval.

packageArguments.description: Start the stdio MCP server rather than the interactive CLI.

environmentVariables.name: DIAVLOS_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Data directory. Defaults to ~/.diavlos. Keep it short: the helper's Unix socket path lives inside it and the kernel caps that at 107 bytes.

environmentVariables.name: DIAVLOS_AS
environmentVariables.description: Which local key to act as. Created on first use. Defaults to 'default'.
